# Pesher Habakkuk Column 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**7:1** "Therefore he-unsheathes his-sword continually

**7:2** to-slay nations

**7:3** without mercy" (Hab 1:17).

**7:4** Its pesher concerns the-Kittim, who destroy

**7:5** many with-the-sword — youths, adults, and-the-aged,

**7:6** women and-children; and-even upon-the-fruit-of

**7:7** the-womb they-have no mercy.

**7:8** "I-will-stand at-my-watch

**7:9** and-station-myself on-my-watchtower, and-I-will-wait to-see

**7:10** what He-will-say to-me, and-what I-shall-reply

**7:11** to-my-complaint. And-the-LORD answered-me

**7:12** and-said: 'Write-down the-vision and-make-it-plain

**7:13** upon the-tablets, so-that the-one-who-reads-it

**7:14** may-run'" (Hab 2:1-2).

**7:15** Its pesher: God told Habakkuk to-write-down the-things

**7:16** that-were-coming upon the-last generation,

**7:17** but the-fulfillment-of the-end-time He-did-not make-known to-him.

---
*EMET notes: Column 7 covers Hab 1:17-2:2. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
